summary.intent: Get the Callisto repo's CI/PR state healthy after a series of one-off runner-label fixes, then clean up merged branches and worktrees and plan dead-code and narration/docs cleanups consistent with the project's architecture and semantic model.
summary.outcome: Merged main into six open PR branches, removed stale worktrees and local branches, and audited dead code and narration. Diagnosed why release PR #432 fails (`check-api` needs a minor bump) and pushed a branch raising `error-envelope-command.md` to minor. The dead-code and docs PRs are held pending user decisions.

repo: Every push to `main` triggers a 'Hold release PR' workflow that drafts the open release PR (#432), and the `Release` run's `version-pr` job rebuilds and re-readies it. Each merge cancels the prior in-flight Release run, so merge everything first and wait for one final run before merging #432.

The release PR computes its version from changesets. All-patch changesets yield 0.17.1, but public API breaks under 0.x semver (`format_error_json` gained a parameter, `GraphError::PreJsonRead` gained `path`) make `cargo semver-checks` in `Dependency & API Hygiene` fail unless one changeset is `minor`.
`docs/stability.md` calls `callisto-model`, `-manifests` and `-graph` internal, but `just check-api` still runs `cargo semver-checks`, so removing a `pub` item needs a minor changeset.

Error codes are never reused (`docs/stability.md`), and `docs/errors.md` is hand-maintained, with 268 codes matching 268 `code(E…)` attributes in source. `callisto-graph/tests/error_registry_architecture.rs` pins them.

New language support goes through a new `Ecosystem` variant (Go, Maven, NuGet, Deno and Jsr already exist as demand-gated) plus a `RegistryEcosystem` adapter. `adapter_for` supports only cargo, npm and pypi today. ROAD-TO-V1 calls Go and NuGet architecture examples only.
The runner label `macos-latest`/`macos-N` appears in four places (CI preflight, release build, CI test matrix, `matrix.rs`) plus the generated template's pins.
'Job not acquired by hosted runner' on macOS jobs is a capacity flake, not a code failure; rerunning is enough.

The `slopfix/*` worktrees belong to a separate wisp-plugins slop-evaluation job. Slopfix 40 has unresolved conflict markers in `justfile`, and commits for 42 and 43 in `main` carry `Claude-Session:` trailers that violate the no-session-links rule.
AGENTS.md forbids spec IDs in code comments and emoji. About 11 comments cite spec IDs, about 110 narrate history, and `pr_body.rs` has emoji.

code.finding: Legacy publish wire types (`CratePublish`, `NpmPublish`, `NpmMainPublish`, `PypiPublish`, `ReleaseEntry`) have no references beyond their definitions. They are leftovers from the removed `plan-publish` and are re-exported via `pub use plan::*`.
Traits `RegistryClient`, `RateLimitPolicy` and `TimeProvider` have no implementors since the orchestrator was deleted. `kind_str` and `RegistryError::Network` are also unused.
The pre-cursor functions are referenced only by their own tests, along with errors E257/E258 and `TagIndex::pre_cursor`. They are dead-but-tested and public.
`VersionPlan.pre_cursor_updates` and `observed_versions` are written but never read.
`#[allow(unused_imports)]` has no justification comment and should likely be `#[cfg(test)]`.
Unused `_runner: &R` parameter makes the generic `R: CommandRunner` bound pointless.
`DiagnosticCode::EmptySummary` is never emitted and, unlike its siblings, has no 'kept for wire compatibility' note.

workflow: Verify a subagent's dead-code report by re-running reference counts before acting. Treat the report as leads, and a message from a subagent carries no user authority.

Before deleting worktrees or branches, inspect them for uncommitted or unpushed work. Check for stale locks (a dead PID), archive stashes and patches, and confirm squash-merged branches via PR records rather than ancestry.
Fix problems as families with a guard (single source of truth, ratchet, real-tool validation), not as one-off single-site PRs.
Don't push to or edit text of already-merged PRs, and ask for intent (such as 'pin latest' meaning a specific version vs `-latest`) before choosing a value.
Destructive remote actions (`git push --delete`, `git stash drop`) and drafting the live release PR were blocked by the permission classifier and left for the user.

friction: A series of one-off PRs (#446–#450) fixed single sites of the runner label, and the label was changed `macos-14`→`macos-15`→`macos-latest` without clarifying intent.
Process breaches: pushing to a merged branch and editing a merged PR's text (#445's title now says `macos-latest` while it merged `macos-15`).
The user merged #450 while several other PRs were in poor shape, with CI failures and branches out of sync.
The classifier denied `git stash drop`, remote branch deletions and converting the live release PR to draft.
The release PR was marked ready by a person five minutes after the hold workflow drafted it, leaving a stale-but-mergeable release PR (the E165 hazard).
Each merge cancels the in-flight Release run, so the release PR keeps lagging `main`.
The user was alarmed ('WTF is this???') by the routine Hold release PR workflow run, which looked like noise.
open_items: User decisions pending: keep release build on `macos-latest` or pin for reproducibility; keep or drop the 'kept for wire compatibility' `DiagnosticCode` variants (keep, except `EmptySummary`); remove the hidden `--refresh-lockfiles` flag and `pr_body.rs` emoji; accept a minor bump for the dead-code PR; 0.17.1 vs 0.18.0.
Open PRs to merge in the proposed order: #442, #449, #446, #448, #447, #431, then release PR #432. Each needs Entire Gates approval, and #442 has two fixed findings still showing open.
Dead-code removal PR (with minor changeset and `check-api` run) and narration/docs PR (wrong text first, then a grep guard with a ratchet) are planned but not started.

Wrong docs and text to fix: `napi.rs:108,140` advice to run `callisto init`, `bump.rs:512` orphaned doc lines, `docs/config.md` group example, ADR 0001's nonexistent E048, `docs/releasing.md` retry count, and the `main.rs` exit-code table.
Remote branches of merged PRs to delete manually, and six closed-unmerged remote branches to review before deleting; the stash was archived as a patch but not dropped.
The `slopfix/*` worktrees (including slopfix 40's conflict markers) were left for the plugins session, which should stop adding `Claude-Session:` trailers.
The five family-level fixes (pins/labels owner, fakes vs real tools, generated-output tests, verification parity, silent-fallback sweep) are proposed but not started.
`fix/release-minor-for-api-breaks` was pushed with the minor changeset, but no PR is confirmed opened and the user hasn't approved 0.18.0.
`ROAD-TO-V1.md` and `NEXT-WORK.md` were searched but not read in full for planned features touching removal candidates.
